title: t2: output = fixed symbol map of the token at position 3 (head 0.0 -> mlp0)
label: verified
behavior: BOS + 6 tokens from {do, du, go, gu, la, ta}; one symbol is output at the last position.
summary: All numbers are from the local-full backend (full precision). The model outputs a fixed re-labelling of the third input token (sequence position 3, BOS = 0): do->do, gu->gu, la->la, du->go, go->ta, ta->du. No other input position influences the output. Head 0.0 attends from the last position to position 3 with weight 1.0 and moves that token; it has no direct effect on the logits. mlp0 reads what head 0.0 wrote and produces the output symbol. Heads 0.1 and 0.2 play no part. On 200 held-out inputs the algorithm matches the model 200/200; ablating {0.0, mlp0} drops accuracy to 0.16 (chance), ablating everything else leaves it at 1.0.

claims.text: The model performs the behaviour perfectly on its own labels (accuracy 1.0, n=200).
The output depends only on the token at position 3: patching the layer-0 residual input at position 3 restores 100% of the metric, every other position 0%.
The function is a fixed map of that token: do->do, gu->gu, la->la, du->go, go->ta, ta->du. It agrees with the model on 200/200 held-out inputs.
Head 0.0 is necessary: mean-ablating it leaves 0.002 of the clean metric. It attends from position 6 to position 3 with weight 1.0.
mlp0 is necessary (mean ablation leaves 0.002 of clean), and head 0.0 has zero direct effect on the logits, so the head's output reaches the answer only through mlp0.
Heads 0.1 and 0.2 play no part: jointly mean-ablating them leaves 100% of the clean metric.
The circuit {0.0, mlp0} is necessary and sufficient on held-out data: circuit ablated -> accuracy 0.16; everything else ablated -> accuracy 1.0; all effects beat their null controls.

nodes.label: head 0.0: last position attends to position 3
mlp0: symbol map (du->go, go->ta, ta->du, others unchanged)

limitations: The symbol map was read off the dataset examples (E0001) and confirmed by held-out agreement (V0001); I did not separately measure whether the three-symbol rotation is done inside mlp0 or split between head 0.0's OV write, mlp0 and the unembedding. Only the combined path is established.

The attention pattern in E0009 suggests head 0.0 looks a fixed three positions back from every query position, but only the last position (6 -> 3) was tested with a pre-registered run, so 'position 3' and 'three back from the end' are not distinguished; they are the same thing at fixed length 7.

V0001 lists random_same_size_ablated_fraction as 1.0 for three random sets, which is odd for a 4-component model where most 2-component sets include a circuit component; the null-control tables in the same result pass, but I did not investigate this field.
What heads 0.1 and 0.2 compute (they attend mostly to positions 4 and 5) was not studied, only that removing them changes nothing.
open_questions: Which neurons of mlp0 (12 available) implement the map, and how is the token encoded in head 0.0's output?
